name: Parle G Oats and Berries Biscuits
ingredients_raw: Refined wheat flour (maida) (64.5%), sugar, refined palm oil, dried sweetened cranberry (5%), rolled oats (5%), invert sugar syrup, raising agents [503(ii), 500(ii)], iodised salt, raisins (1.1%), barley flour (0.5%), emulsifier (472e) of vegetable origin. Contains permitted added flavours (artificial flavouring substances - cranberry and cereal).
